purpose: Qualitative demand/friction intelligence for the single Stödassistenten learning system. These scores are not measured search volumes and do not prove eligibility or factual truth. Community discussion is discovery-only; preventive-sickness-benefit facts must be verified against current Försäkringskassan primary sources and remain review-gated in the truth layer.

scoring.priority_rule: Prioritize combinations of high demand, high friction, high consequence and weak current product coverage. Scores are qualitative prioritization, not measured search volume.

demand_signal.basis: Public discussion shows people framing recurring treatment during work as a scheduling, disclosure or ordinary-sick-leave question rather than knowing the preventive-sickness-benefit term. This is qualitative discovery only, not measured search volume.

friction_signal.basis: The route is easy to confuse with an ordinary doctor visit, ordinary sickness benefit, employer rehabilitation, work training or wellness. The official process also has a two-stage structure: treatment-plan approval first, then claims for actual treatment occasions.

miss_consequence.basis: A missed route can lead a person to skip medically important recurring treatment, use the wrong absence path, or fail to obtain the treatment-plan approval needed before claiming the specific benefit.

source_fragmentation.basis: Core user conditions and application steps are on one Försäkringskassan page, while the healthcare guidance adds important boundaries such as single visits not qualifying and individual assessment.

language_accessibility_friction.basis: Natural wording centers on therapy, rehab, physiotherapy, work hours and being able to work between appointments. The support name itself is unlikely to be the phrase a new user starts with, especially across Swedish, Arabic and Persian.

steps_to_action.basis: The user must distinguish the treatment type, actual absence per occasion and treatment-plan approval status before reaching the safe application step. Asking generic work or diagnosis questions first adds avoidable friction.

recurrence_signal.basis: The same friction recurs with scheduled psychology, pain treatment, physiotherapy, occupational therapy and other recurring medical rehabilitation that overlaps work or job-seeking time.

current_product_coverage_gap.basis: The truth layer already contains a review-gated preventive-sickness-benefit support record, but the public shell/person journey has no focused natural-language route that consumes it. The employee coverage matrix also identifies long-tail combinations between work and benefits as a remaining gap.

signals.recommended_learning_action: Add a bounded preventive_treatment handoff inside the existing shared shell/person module. Detect recurring treatment or rehabilitation plus work-time friction, pass only actor/focus/language, ask only doctor-order/purpose, per-occasion absence and treatment-plan-approval facts that can change the path, and keep ordinary sickness benefit and employer rehabilitation separate instead of forcing every treatment visit into this benefit.
signals.truth_rule: Discovery discussions may reveal wording and friction only. Verify current treatment-purpose, doctor-order, time-threshold, plan-approval and application facts against Försäkringskassan primary sources before they affect truth-bearing behavior. Do not promote the existing support record or any material field from NEEDS_REVIEW to VERIFIED without the required human review chain.
